title: Pakistan Suspends Trade and Closes Iran Border Crossings
excerpt: Pakistan has shut down official border crossings with Iran in Balochistan, halting trade operations due to security concerns.
body_html:
Pakistan has halted trade activities with neighboring Iran by shutting down official border crossings located in Balochistan. Authorities have suspended movement through the Taftan and Gabd-Rimdan border points.

According to officials, the decision to close the crossings was made due to security reasons. No further details regarding the duration of the suspension or specific incidents prompting the closure have been provided at this time.
